{if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}A {c_important}{u}Pestilent Swarm{/u}{/c} spawns from you every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds, dealing {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * Affix_Value_1]{/c} Poison damage per hit. 

Your {c_important}{u}Pestilent Swarms{/u}{/c} now orbit around you and reduce an equipped Eagle Skill's cooldown by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"|2|]{/c} seconds per hit.{if:SF.IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}
